data_format: original V8; byte-identical fixed 10% data index
B1: A5 all-global attention plus trainable per-channel attention/FFN residual scales, initialized to 0.1
B2: 8 blocks: chain-local attention then global attention then SwiGLU FFN; FFN width 2048; fixed residual scales 0.1
B3: B2 plus trainable per-channel residual scales on all three sublayers, initialized to 0.1
parameter_budget: approximately 75.75M each; extra attention in B2/B3 is paid for by reducing FFN width from 3072 to 2048
scientific_scope: Single-seed architectural screening with unchanged MLM/family objectives, decoding, datasets and evaluation partitions; no significance or causal mechanism claim
hierarchy_inspiration: PoET-2 encoder chain-local then global attention, https://arxiv.org/html/2508.04724v2#S3.SS2.SSS4
limitations: B2/B3 jointly change attention organization and the allocation of attention versus FFN parameters.
This is a sequence-only adaptation, not a reproduction of PoET-2 retrieval, structural inputs or dual decoders.
AAR alone does not establish conditional or binding specificity.
